seo.pirateDescription: Every way on board NO Anchor University: B.Tech through the Great Sea Trials, M.Sc., MBA, M.A., Ph.D. and executive programmes. A hackathon parody of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.

original.title: Admissions

original.heading: Important Notice
paragraphs: All new students must be able to swim 50 metres. A swimming test will be held on the day of reporting.
Full tuition fee waivers are available to the ten highest-ranked candidates in the Great Sea Trials 2026.
A five-year dual degree, B.Tech. in Mining Engineering with an MBA in Treasure Logistics, will be offered from 2026 with an intake of 60.
All students reporting for admission must submit a medical certificate. Seasickness is not a ground for refusal of admission.

pirate.heading: Read this before you board
paragraphs: Everyone must be able to swim 50 metres. There is a test on reporting day. There is also a lifeboat, but it is not part of the test.
Full fee waiver for the top ten candidates in the Great Sea Trials 2026.
New: a five-year dual degree with 60 seats, a B.Tech in Mining Engineering plus an MBA in Treasure Logistics. Dig it up, then ship it.
Bring a medical certificate. Seasickness will not stop you getting in. It may stop you enjoying the first week.

cells: Full-time Ph.D. for candidates selected through our own procedure, with an Institute Assistantship.
For candidates who already hold a national research fellowship.
For working professionals with at least two years of experience.
Co-supervised with a partner university. At least one semester is spent at sea, which is excellent for focus and terrible for Wi-Fi.

original.heading: Executive Masters Programmes
paragraphs: The Executive Masters Programmes are designed for working professionals from government, industry and academia who wish to pursue advanced study while remaining in employment.
The two-year Executive M.Tech. is offered in Petroleum Engineering, Artificial Intelligence & Data Science and Mechanical Engineering.
The Executive MBA develops leadership, strategic thinking and business acumen for working executives.
International candidates may contact the Dean (International Relations).

pirate.heading: Executive programmes: keep the day job
paragraphs: The two-year Executive M.Tech is for working professionals from government, industry and universities who want advanced study without leaving their jobs.
Three are on offer: Petroleum Engineering, Artificial Intelligence & Data Science, and Mechanical Engineering.
The Executive MBA is built for working executives: leadership, strategy and business sense, taught around a full-time job.
International candidates can contact the Dean (International Relations).

aside.label: Navigator’s note
aside.text: Studying while working is like sailing while fixing the sails. Plenty of our crew manage it.
